warnings: moved open_prepared to the front — every later step acts on that screen

steps.note: Open the prepared closed RFQ's summary page.
Enable eRFX projects as required by the case.
Keep post-expiry surrogate bidding disabled as required.
Enable buyer bid editing as required by the case configuration.
Keep evaluation reopening restricted as required.
Open Order Activity from the RFQ stage Settings menu without taking any action in the resulting drawer.
Assert that the Activity window or drawer opened.
